depends_on: odd period of sqrt(m) implies x^2 - m y^2 = -1 is solvable (classical)
notes: Odd period => x^2 - m y^2 = -1 => every odd prime factor of m is 1 mod 4 (Lean: prime_dvd_of_negPell); so an odd period dividing m, and every odd m with period | m, lies in A004613 (odd_divisor_A004613, odd_m_A004613). check.py: m < 300000. Outside Lean: the classical odd-period => negative Pell step.

prior_art.note: Textbook argument; no prior write-up for this conjecture found.
